title: AI Time-Series Regime Detection System
description:
Production-grade regime detection for high-dimensional time-series data using HMM + KMeans and XGBoost transition prediction.

Key outcomes:
- 65-75% transition prediction accuracy
- 17+ years of data processed
- +56% improvement in risk-adjusted performance
- Streamlit deployment for live monitoring and risk heatmaps

title: Retail Demand Forecasting & Inventory Optimization
description:
End-to-end SKU-level next-week demand forecasting pipeline combining Prophet + XGBoost with rule-based reorder recommendations.

Highlights:
- Airflow ETL for retail data pipelines
- Postgres-backed analytical workflows
- Backtesting across multiple regions and market conditions
- Dashboard experience using Streamlit/React
